hero.line2: with the blessings of our families

welcome.message: invite you and your family to grace their wedding with your presence and blessings, as they take the seven sacred vows and begin their new life together.

venue.title: Vivah Sthal
venue.name: Jagmandir Palace
venue.text1: Set on the waters of Lake Pichola, Jagmandir Palace will be the setting for our vivah, with its marble courtyards and views of the old city.
venue.text2: We request you to arrive a little early, so you can settle in and join the baraat with the family.

day.title: Vivah Karyakram
day.subtitle2: from the baraat to the last dance.

items.title: Baraat
items.text: The groom arrives with music, dhol and dancing, and the families greet each other at the Milni.

items.title: Jaimala & Pheras
items.text: The couple exchange garlands, then take the seven pheras around the sacred fire.

items.title: Swagat
items.text: Refreshments and thandai on the terrace while the family gathers for photographs.

items.title: Shubh Bhoj
items.text: A traditional wedding feast under the stars, shared with family and friends.

items.title: Sangeet
items.text: An evening of music and dancing with the whole family, celebrating until late.

dress.title: Dress Code
dress.subtitle: Traditional Indian Attire
dress.text: We'd love to see you in lehengas, sarees, sherwanis and kurtas, in the bright colours of celebration.

transport.title: Transportation
transport.text1: We want getting to and from the wedding to be as easy as possible for you and your family.
transport.text2: A private boat will depart at 4:00 PM from Lal Ghat, taking guests directly to Jagmandir Palace with plenty of time to join the baraat.
transport.text3: After the celebrations, return transport to the city will

stay.title: Where to Stay
stay.subtitle: For our guests travelling from out of town, we've selected two lovely places to stay close to the venue.

hotels.name: Lakeside Haveli
hotels.text: A short walk from the jetty, this haveli offers a comfortable stay with views across Lake Pichola.

hotels.name: The Old City Courtyard
hotels.text: A charming heritage hotel in the old city, combining Mewar character with a peaceful atmosphere.

gift.title: Shagun
gift.text: Your blessings are our greatest gift.
gift.options: Should you wish to give shagun, you may do so in person or by UPI.

gallery.title: Our Moments
gallery.subtitle: A few memories from our journey so far, with many more to come.

closing.message: We await your presence and blessings.
